title: Phase 2 Screening — final desktop and mobile

MobileApprove.dc.html.title: M7 · Approve a generation on the phone

q1.text: UNCLEAR needs a contract decision (plan §2). Unclear is drawn as a first-class outcome (D2, D4, D7, D8, M3, M6), but ScreeningDecisionValue has no UNCLEAR today. It needs an architecture/version decision, regenerated schemas and golden fixtures, a negative regression test and review before any code.

q2.text: Open: exclusion reason codes. Drawn as the protocol's EXC-01..03 plus 'Fails INC-0n' for each inclusion criterion (D4, M4, PRISMA reasons on D8). Confirm the protocol's exclusion list should be generated this way, or name the codes in the protocol.

q3.text: Open: approval code. D1 (phone pairing), D8 and M7 all show 731-942. Is the approval code the per-launch pairing code, or a fresh one-time code per generation? For desktop-only approval, typing a code shown on the same screen proves a deliberate act, not a second device.

q4.text: Open: the sample check of agreed exclusions (D6) when you decide every record yourself. Drawn as a blind re-look at 60 of the 1,042 records you and the agent both excluded (a fatigue check). Keep it, change the size, or drop it?

q5.text: Open: the 30-label check of the agent (D3) is optional and advisory. Should a missed include in that check block the full proposal run, as the grey Calibrate gate did, or stay a warning?

q6.text: Open: refusal codes SNAPSHOT_NOT_ACCEPTED, PROVENANCE_MISSING, ENGINE_UNREACHABLE, DECISION_CONFLICT and RATE_LIMITED (D2, D7) are proposed names; only STALE_BINDING and APPROVAL_MISSING are known from the code. Fix the names in the final specs.

q7.text: Open: the desktop cannot count decisions waiting on an offline phone (D7, Phone offline). Should approval require every paired phone to report 0 queued first (M7 shows it), or warn and allow?

q8.text: Open: the cost estimate (D3) shows tokens; the dollar figure for a BYO key needs a price source and a date. Where does it come from, and is MCP usage shown at all?

decided.text: Decided in this pass: the two lanes are the agent and you; a second human screener is parked. Every record gets your decision (method HUMAN); agent output is a draft with model, prompt hash and date. The proposal is hidden until you decide (D4, M3) and revealed after (D5, M5); the setting lives in Prepare and is recorded in provenance. Agreement with the agent is percent plus a 2x2, captioned 'not an inter-rater statistic'; kappa is disabled. The Calibrate board is folded into D3 as an optional 30-label check, never against a heuristic (S6). The missing corpus snapshot is a blocked state with a one-click fix (S7); seeded shuffle (S8). One approval per generation (S9). Files are checked on arrival and quarantined with a reason (S11). Missing fields are refused, never defaulted (S3). Title-only records route to Unclear, not Exclude (S1). Phone: QR pairing, swipe right Include / left Exclude / up Unclear, Skip is a button, one-tap reason sheet, 5 s undo as a superseding decision, offline queue that sends once, conflicts shown and never auto-resolved. CLI appears only as 'Run from the terminal'.

parked.text: Not production: Full text, Synthesis, Matrix, Graph and Trust phases (struck through in the stepper with a 'Not production' marker). Second screener and Cohen's kappa (team feature, D1 and D6). Reloading the phone page while offline keeps nothing: it needs a service worker over HTTPS (plan §4), so M6 tells you to keep the page open.
